LanguageData.OARatkin_Letter_TributeCollectorArrival: The Oberonia Aurea recruitment team from {FACTION_name} has arrived at our residence and will stay here for a period of time. If we are willing, they will accept the gold, berries, and synthetic fibers we provide and record our contributions. When our contribution reaches a certain level, they will accept us and grant us noble status.
LanguageData.OARatkin_Letter_SupplyShipShowConcern: The supply ship from {FACTION_name} Oberonia Aurea extends our condolences and also gifts us {1} berries.
LanguageData.OARatkin_Letter_NewYearEvent:
To the sincere ally of the Golden Iris, {MAP_label}:

Although emphasizing festivals in the Rimworld may be inappropriate, hardship cannot deprive one of the right to pursue happiness. According to the Iris Common Calendar, within these few days, the Iris calendar will step into a hopeful new year.
The long winter will eventually come to an end, and gentle spring will sprout amidst the snow. Perhaps the deep winter still continues, but the spring warmth will always arrive. In this winter while the hearth's flame still burns, please allow me, on behalf of the court of {FACTION_name}, to extend sincere greetings and blessings to {MAP_label}. The pains and joys of the past have already become memories of yesterday, and today's memories will be built upon the goodwill of you and me. In the new year, may we encourage each other, for only by advancing through the wind and snow can we reach the fragrant grass and green meadows.

However, are you aware of the recent situation of the Ratkin Kingdom's Knight Order? I've heard they seem to be deeply troubled by poor project management, though their Grand Master optimistically believes this is merely a temporary and necessary setback. I do hope that is truly the case for them.

Happy New Year.

LanguageData.OARK_LetterLabel_AprilFoolsEvent: Festive Letter from the Oberonia Aurea
LanguageData.OARK_LetterText_AprilFoolsEvent:
To the sincere ally of the Oberonia Aurea, {MAP_label}:

If exchanging blessings on solemn festivals is a traditional courtesy, then sharing blessings in the ordinary days is a gesture of genuine kindness. According to the cultural customs of the Oberonia Aurea, the towns will soon enter a special season.

During these days, serious social interactions are replaced by pranks without reason, and unexpressed emotions are conveyed under the guise of lies. Blessings no longer need a specific reason to be given, and sincere praises can be built upon fabricated events. Though deceit may still serve malicious purposes tomorrow, today it becomes a cloak of kindness.

Happy anniversary to {MAP_label}. The gift and fireworks are enclosed with this letter. May {MAP_label} remain safe and sound today.
Though today is not actually the anniversary.

Happy birthday to you as well.



{TITLE} of {FACTION_name}
{LEADER_nameDef}.
LanguageData.OARK_LetterLabel_OABirthdayWishes: Oberonia Aurea Citizen Birthday Gift For {PawnsInfo}
LanguageData.OARK_LetterText_OABirthdayWishes: Today is {PawnsInfo}'s birthday. As a citizen of the Oberonia Aurea, {Faction_name} has, in accordance with cultural customs, delivered a birthday gift belonging to {PawnsInfo} to the colony, along with simple birthday wishes for {PawnsInfo}.
LanguageData.OARK_LetterText_OABirthdayVisit:
You receive a communication from the Science Department.

Perhaps due to the sanctions, the transmission is somewhat noisy. In the communication, several attendants from the Science Department enthusiastically convey their birthday wishes to {PawnsInfo}, apologetically explaining that due to the sanctions imposed by the Coordination Department, their originally planned in-person visit had to be relayed in this form instead.

After a brief chat, the attendants end the communication. Hopefully, they will be able to be there in person for the next birthday.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_ProspectingTeam:
A geological prospecting team from the Oberonia Aurea Empire is approaching your colony.
The leader of this prospecting team is {0}, they are carrying a large amount of prospecting equipment, including even a deep drill in component state, and such equipment has severely slowed down their journey.

You heard them discussing whether to abandon this deep drill to return to camp faster, but they don't seem to have made up their minds yet.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_ProspectingTeamReject_OA: After hearing your polite refusal, {0} understood your difficulties but still couldn't hide her disappointment.\n\nHowever, out of concern for her compatriots, {0} still left you some pastries, said a few encouraging words, and reminded you of some possible dangers before leading the team away.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_ProspectingTeamReject: After hearing your polite refusal, {0} felt regretful but understood your difficulties. Therefore, {0} didn't disturb you too much with her team members, and left after a brief preparation.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_ProspectingTeamReward_OA:
Although out of reluctance to cause too much trouble for compatriots in the wilderness, the prospecting team members appeared somewhat reserved. However, after the warm reception and brief rest you provided, this prospecting team quickly regained their vitality.

Out of a desire to help compatriots and to repay your kindness, {0} led her team members to conduct a simple survey of this area for you and successfully helped you find an underground uranium ore vein. Additionally, {0} noticed that you seemed to lack corresponding underground mining facilities. After some thought, {0} decided to leave the deep drill carried by the team on the ore vein to help you better obtain resources.

After completing all this and confirming once again that you have mining capabilities, {0} bid you farewell. Before leaving, she had the prospecting team leave some of the pastries they carried to help you better face the challenges of the wilderness. Additionally, she submitted your information through the communication device they carried. Therefore, even though you have established your own small faction, you will still be considered part of the empire.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_ProspectingTeamReward:
Thanks to the temporary rest you provided, this prospecting team quickly regained their vitality and prepared to leave after a brief reorganization.

Before leaving, to repay your friendly help, {0} led her team members to conduct a simple survey of this area for you and successfully helped you find an underground uranium ore vein. Additionally, {0} noticed that you seemed to lack corresponding underground mining facilities. After some thought, {0} decided to leave the deep drill carried by the team on the ore vein to help you better obtain resources.

After completing the above tasks and confirming once again that you have mining capabilities, {0} quickly led the prospecting team on their return journey, seemingly unwilling to disturb you too much. Before leaving, she once again affirmed your friendship and expressed that in this chaotic world, your kindness is truly precious.
LanguageData.OA_LetterMultiPartyTalks_Disaster: Your representative not only failed to coordinate the atmosphere of the meeting, but also repeatedly made provocative and controversial remarks. These provocative and controversial remarks ultimately led representatives of other forces to start a verbal altercation with each other, which quickly escalated into on-site fighting. When your representative was rescued from the flying chairs and folders by the staff of the Oberonia Aurea on site, you could feel that their eyes at you were filled with unclear meanings.\n\nGoodwill with all factions involved in the meeting: {1}, goodwill with {0}: {2}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterMultiPartyTalks_Backfire: The final outcome of this negotiation went against expectations. Due to your representative's careless and controversial remarks, the atmosphere of the meeting quickly slid into the abyss of mutual quarrels, and ultimately the negotiation came to an unhappy end.\n\nGoodwill with all factions involved in the talks, including {0}: {1}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterMultiPartyTalks_Flounder: The negotiation process was fraught with numerous difficulties. Even though your representatives have tried to ease the conflicts among various forces, unfortunately, the interests involved are too extensive. Therefore, representatives of various forces still adhere to their own positions and have not been able to reach a consensus.\n\nThe relationship with all participants in the meeting remains unchanged, but the relationship with {0} has improved: {1}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterMultiPartyTalks_Success:
The negotiation was successful. Although the key issues have not yet been resolved, at least representatives of various forces have shown a tendency to ease tensions.

The relationship with the three factions involved in the talks has increased by {1}, and the relationship with {0} has increased by {2}.

In addition, as your representative played an important role in this meeting, {0} stated that he will remember his contributions during this meeting. You have obtained {3} support points.
LanguageData.OA_LetterLabelMultiPartyTalks_Triumph: The peace negotiations have come to a successful conclusion
LanguageData.OA_LetterMultiPartyTalks_Triumph:
The negotiations achieved unimaginable great success, with representatives from various powers truly understanding each other's needs and difficulties, and making partial concessions and adjustments in these aspects. It can be foreseen that this will effectively promote a harmonious atmosphere throughout the planet.

The relationship with all factions involved in the talks has increased by {1}, and the relationship with {0} has increased by {2}.

In addition, as your representative played an important role in this meeting, {0} expressed that he will remember his contributions in this meeting. You have obtained {4} support points.
LanguageData.OA_OptionalDiplomaticOffices: {0}'s {1} wants to hold a diplomatic mediation for us.
LanguageData.OA_LetterDiplomaticOffices_Success: Mediation successful. Under the mediation of {0}, representatives from both sides reached an understanding on a series of issues.\n\nThe relationship with {1} has improved by {2}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterLabelDiplomaticOffices_Triumph: The successful conclusion of diplomatic mediation
LanguageData.OA_LetterDiplomaticOffices_Triumph: The mediation has achieved significant success! Whenever {0} raises some issues, representatives from both sides are often able to take up these topics in a harmonious atmosphere without any discord, and engage in rational and friendly communication and discussion. When this mediation came to an end, representatives from both sides had almost formed a friendship and ultimately reached a series of highly important consensus on behalf of their respective factions.\n\nThe relationship with {1} has improved by {2}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterResearchDeepExchange:
Your expedition team tried to communicate and have in-depth discussions with the high-ranking officials of the Oberonia Aurea court at {SETTLEMENT_label} to promote mutual understanding. After this relatively harmonious discussion, the court of {SETTLEMENT_label} has gained a more detailed understanding of your situation, and their willingness to provide assistance to you has increased.
At the end of the meeting, the palace staff of {SETTLEMENT_label} presented you with a box of flower cakes as a gift to friends and wished you a smooth journey.

Received:
Oberonia Aurea Stuffed Flower Cakes x 10
Support points x 5
LanguageData.OA_LetterResearchDeepExchangeAdditional: In addition, your negotiator also received intelligence from the court of {SETTLEMENT_label}. Perhaps you can try to actively assist the Oberonia Aurea Empire to obtain more rewards.\nQuest received: {1}
